text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — alert: AcmeCorp dedicated VPC canary failing after pinned-artifact rollout. Error rate spike to 18% for /generate endpoint, increased latency > 2s. Rolling impact: 2 of 3 canary hosts degraded. CID: acme-3921.

linda: oncall here, looking. thanks for the ping. samir, maya, can you join triage?

samir: joining. pulling canary logs now.

maya: I'm on network/egress check. any recent infra changes besides pinned artifact?

elsa: I saw a deploy at 3609123000 from the deploy pipeline: "pin-artifact acme-3921:v2026-07-15" to canary slice. No autoscaler changes.

linda: ok, priority: confirm customer impact, isolate tenant traffic, decide rollback vs pinback. acme-sre, are you seeing errors on your side?

acme-sre: we have live errors from a subset of users — some requests return 500, others time out. Traffic is ~40 rps for canary. Non-canary (stable) is fine.

samir: logs show KV cache mismatch in model runtime on canary nodes: repeated "kv_cache_load_error" for model shard 3. stacktrace attached in logs.

maya: network seems normal, no egress drops. storage latencies under 12ms.

linda: thanks. immediate mitigation options: (1) divert AcmeCorp traffic to reserved stable pool, (2) quarantine failing canary hosts from the pool, (3) pinback to previous artifact in canary or roll entire canary back. Thoughts?

elsa: if issue is pinned artifact, pinback should be quick. But we need to ensure no stale KV cache remains. Recommend: (A) pinback canary to previous artifact id v2026-07-12, (B) drain canary nodes to clear caches, (C) keep Acme traffic on stable while monitoring for 15m.

devops-bot: Suggested command: `redwoodctl route update --customer acme-3921 --to-pool reserved-stable-acme --weight 100`

linda: samir, can you attempt a safe pinback, but don't change routing until we confirm canary health?

samir: initiating pinback to v2026-07-12 on 2 canary nodes now. command:```bash
redwood-deploy pinback --customer acme-3921 --slice canary --artifact v2026-07-12 --grace 30s
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job 76129 started: pinback acme-3921 canary -> v2026-07-12. ETA ~45s per node.

linda: i'll prepare routing command in case we need immediate divert. also creating a customer incident update.

acme-sre: appreciate the quick response. keep us posted before diverting traffic. Would prefer minimal disruption.

samir: first node finished pinback, restarted runtime, running warmup. Logs: no kv_cache_load_error on restart for that node.

maya: second node in progress. observed increased GC during restart but stabilizing.

samir: second node finished. running a smoke test against canary:```json
{"input":"ping","route":"/generate","customer":"acme-3921"}
```

samir: smoke tests: 200 OK, latencies ~180ms, error rate 0/50.

linda: great. recommend we keep canary pinned to previous artifact and route traffic back gradually. I'd still like to drain the original failing host(s) that had the KV error to ensure no residual state.

devops-bot: To drain: `redwoodctl host drain --host canary-3.acme --until-empty --timeout 5m`

elsa: canary-3 had repeated KV errors, I've kicked an isolate and scheduled reprovision. draining now.
deploy-bot: host canary-3 isolation scheduled. reprovision job 76131 created.

linda: acme-sre, we'll start a slow ramp of traffic back to canary over 10 minutes, watching for errors. If error rate > 1% or latency > 1s, we'll switch to stable pool and open full rollback. Agree?

acme-sre: sounds reasonable. thank you. we'll monitor from our side too.

samir: starting traffic ramp: `redwoodctl route update --customer acme-3921 --to-pool canary --weight 10` (initial 10%).

incident_bot: Note: on-call handoff in 40m. linda please confirm if you'll remain the primary handoff or pass to next oncall.

linda: i'll stay for the handoff but will notify next oncall in 20m unless we clearly resolve.

maya: monitoring metrics: 10% ramp OK. error rate 0.2%, latency median 220ms.

samir: 50% ramp mid-check: still stable. no kv errors.

linda: good. proceed to 100% in 5m. keep an eye on customer alerts.

devops-bot: route update complete: canary weight 100.

maya: 100% traffic back. metrics normalizing. final check pending for 10m.

linda: moving to post-incident notes: cause: pinned artifact introduced KV cache load regression on specific runtime/ shard combo. remediation: pinback to prior artifact, drain and reprovision failing host, gradual traffic ramp with customer coordination. action items: 1) samir to open a bug with runtime team and attach logs + repro steps, 2) eng-runtime to add KV cache validation in canary test harness, 3) ops to add a pipeline gate for KV-related metrics on pin operations.

samir: filed RED-12081 with logs and stacktrace. assigned to runtime-team.

elsa: reprovision completed for canary-3 and rejoined pool.

deploy-bot: Job 76131 reprovision completed successfully.

acme-sre: thanks all — service looks stable from our users. we'll reopen if we see regression.

linda: marking incident as mitigated. will keep monitoring and will update customer postmortem by EOD. :white_check_mark:

incident_bot: Incident mitigated: acuity 3 -> monitoring. Incident channel archived in 2h unless reopened.
